description: Search remote jobs on Himalayas.app by keyword, filter by employment type, remote policy, and salary, or fetch all jobs for a specific company.

companySlug.description: Canonical company slug from Himalayas (e.g. `stripe`, `gitlab`, `zapier`). Used only in `byCompany` mode.
companySlug.title: Company slug (mode=byCompany)

employmentType.description: Filter results by employment type. Leave blank to return all.
employmentType.title: Employment type filter

jobUrls.description: List of Himalayas job page URLs to enrich (e.g. `https://himalayas.app/companies/stripe/jobs/some-role`). Used only in `byJobUrls` mode.
jobUrls.title: Job URLs (mode=byJobUrls)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of job records emitted.
maxItems.title: Max items

minSalary.description: Exclude jobs whose maximum salary is below this value. Jobs without salary data are also excluded when this filter is set.
minSalary.title: Minimum salary (USD/year)

mode.description: What to scrape. `searchJobs` — keyword search with filters. `byCompany` — all jobs for a company slug. `byJobUrls` — enrich a list of specific job URLs.
enumTitles: All jobs for a company slug
mode.title: Mode

remotePolicy.description: Filter by remote policy. Himalayas is a remote-first platform — all listed jobs are remote. Leave blank to return all, or select `remote` to confirm remote-only results.
remotePolicy.title: Remote policy filter

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword query (used in `searchJobs` mode). Example: `python backend`, `product manager`, `data scientist`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

title: Himalayas Remote Jobs Scraper Input
